questions.definition: A **sacrilege** is the violation or misuse of something considered sacred.
options: an act of stealing religious items
a public holiday celebrating a saint
disrespectful treatment of a sacred place or object
questions.answer: disrespectful treatment of a sacred place or object

questions.definition: The **quintessential** version of something is the perfect example of it, embodying all its best qualities.
options: a rare, old-fashioned version of a product
the most typical and ideal representation
questions.answer: the most typical and ideal representation

questions.definition: When someone **exhumes** an old document, they dig it up from where it has been buried.
options: retrieves it from an archaeological site
questions.answer: retrieves it from an archaeological site

questions.definition: A **subsidy** is financial support given by a government to an industry or business to help it grow or stay competitive.
options: a small donation from private individuals
financial aid provided by the state
questions.answer: financial aid provided by the state

questions.definition: The **replenish** action means to restock something that has been used up, such as supplies or resources.
options: restore or renew the supply of something
questions.answer: restore or renew the supply of something
